Ana (Design): Hey — quick feedback session on the invite drawer mock. Trying a different affordance for role selection: selectable rows (full-width) instead of chips to improve scanability for large role sets. Mock: https://redwood.design/s/invite-rows-v1.png :mag_right:

Dan (Frontend): Full-width rows should help keyboard navigation. Couple notes: make each row a button with role="checkbox" so aria-pressed/aria-checked works. Avoid nested interactive elements that break focus.

Liz (A11y): Agree with Dan. Also ensure the hit target is >=44px and that the visible focus indicator isn't suppressed by background gradients. For SSO state, don't rely on color alone; include text like "SSO enforced" and an aria-label on the state element.

Harper (PM): From product: per-invite SSO toggles are not allowed to override org enforcement. If org enforcement is on, the per-row control should be disabled and show a consistent message. CTA copy should remain 'Invite' with microcopy below when SSO applies.

Ana (Design): Thinking of adding a lightweight inline status row under role label: small grey text 'SSO enforced' or 'SSO optional'. If enforcement is pending (API check), show a neutral spinner and announce when resolved.

Dan (Frontend): Spinner needs aria-live polite to announce resolution. I'll implement lazy-loading of SSO status to avoid 100% DOM churn for huge orgs. Will add keyboard handler to toggle selection with Enter/Space and ensure Shift+arrow works for range select.

Liz (A11y): Range select via Shift+arrow is great, but announce range selection counts via aria-live: "5 roles selected". Also ensure that when disabled due to org policy, the toggle has aria-disabled and a tooltip alternative that's keyboard accessible (e.g., a help button opening a small dialog).

Preview Bot: preview:invite-rows built  https://staging.redwood/preview/invite-rows (sha: jkl345) :white_check_mark:

Dan (Frontend): Ran axe on preview: flagged 1) low contrast on tiny helper text, 2) missing accessible name on per-row info button, 3) focus outline being clipped on wrapped rows. I'll patch those.

Ana (Design): I'll darken helper text and add explicit labels for the info buttons. For the range select microcopy, I'll add a small hint: 'Shift+click to select contiguous roles'. Keep it terse.

Harper (PM): Add analytics events: invite_rows_open, role_row_selected, sso_status_viewed. Timeline: aim for a beta with 5% of orgs next sprint if a11y checks pass. If Liz flags blockers, we'll hold.

Liz (A11y): I'll review the PR once Dan posts it. Quick reminder: test with NVDA and mobile TalkBack for range selection hints.

Ana (Design): Thanks! Will iterate Figma and attach updated frames + alt text in the PR. :sparkles:
